# Feature: Monorepo Scaffold & CI

## 1. Feature Goal

**ID**: FEAT-001
**Source Plan**: `.spec-lite/plan.md`

This feature delivers the foundational repository structure for Yantra: a pnpm + Turborepo monorepo (`packages/protocol`, `packages/core`, `packages/agent`, `apps/cli`, `e2e/`, `docs/`) with TypeScript strict mode, ESM-only output, Vitest, ESLint, Prettier, and a GitHub Actions CI matrix over `LLM_PROVIDER ∈ {anthropic, ollama, none}` (Anthropic and none on all three OSes; **Ollama on `ubuntu-latest` only** to control runtime cost per plan §9). It is the prerequisite for every other feature: no protocol schemas, no executor, no CLI can be written until the toolchain, package boundaries, and CI gate exist. Three invariants are baked in from day one — (a) `packages/agent` cannot import `packages/core` and direct `pi-agent-core` imports are forbidden outside `packages/agent` (enforced by ESLint `no-restricted-imports`); (b) every test tagged `@no-llm` passes on all three OSes with `LLM_PROVIDER=none`; (c) TypeScript strict + ESM-only is the only mode the repo will ever build in.

## 3. Files

Exhaustive list of files this feature creates (paths are repo-relative):

**Root config**

- `package.json` — root workspace; `private: true`, `type: "module"`, `packageManager: "pnpm@9.x"`, scripts (`build`, `test`, `lint`, `typecheck`, `format`, `clean`) all delegate to `turbo run <task>`; declares `devDependencies`: `turbo`, `typescript`, `vitest`, `@vitest/coverage-v8`, `eslint`, `@typescript-eslint/parser`, `@typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin`, `eslint-plugin-import`, `eslint-plugin-vitest`, `prettier`, `eslint-config-prettier`, `lefthook`, `lint-staged`, `@changesets/cli`.
- `pnpm-workspace.yaml` — `packages: ["packages/*", "apps/*", "e2e"]`.
- `.npmrc` — `node-linker=isolated`, `strict-peer-dependencies=true`, `auto-install-peers=false`.
- `.nvmrc` — `24.15.0`.
- `tsconfig.base.json` — `strict: true`, `module: "NodeNext"`, `moduleResolution: "NodeNext"`, `target: "ES2022"`, `lib: ["ES2022"]`, `esModuleInterop: true`, `isolatedModules: true`, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess: true`, `noImplicitOverride: true`, `exactOptionalPropertyTypes: true`, `verbatimModuleSyntax: true`, `forceConsistentCasingInFileNames: true`, `declaration: true`, `declarationMap: true`, `sourceMap: true`, `skipLibCheck: true`.
- `tsconfig.json` — solution-style; `references` array points at every package's `tsconfig.build.json`; `files: []`.
- `turbo.json` — pipeline for `build` (depends on `^build`, outputs `dist/**`), `test` (depends on `build`, `LLM_PROVIDER` in `passThroughEnv`), `lint`, `typecheck`, `clean`.
- `vitest.workspace.ts` — `defineWorkspace([ 'packages/*', 'apps/*', 'e2e' ])`.
- `.eslintrc.cjs` (or `eslint.config.js` flat) — extends `@typescript-eslint/recommended-type-checked` and `prettier`; configures `no-restricted-imports` with the two architectural rules (see TASK-006); `parserOptions.project: true`.
- `.prettierrc` — `{ "singleQuote": true, "semi": true, "trailingComma": "all", "printWidth": 100 }`.
- `.prettierignore` — `dist/`, `node_modules/`, `.turbo/`, `**/*.md`-overrides if needed.
- `.editorconfig` — UTF-8, LF, indent 2 spaces, trim trailing whitespace.
- `.gitignore` — `node_modules/`, `dist/`, `.turbo/`, `coverage/`, `.DS_Store`, `*.tsbuildinfo`, `*.log`, `.env*`, `.vscode/*` (with `!.vscode/settings.json` allowed).
- `.gitattributes` — `* text=auto eol=lf`.
- `lefthook.yml` — pre-commit hook running `pnpm exec lint-staged`; `package.json` declares `lint-staged` config: `*.ts → eslint --fix && prettier --write`, `*.{json,md,yml} → prettier --write`.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — see TASK-008.
- `LICENSE` — MIT (subject to user confirmation in TASK-010).
- `README.md` — skeleton (project title, one-paragraph description, quickstart `pnpm install && pnpm test`, link to `docs/`).
- `CONTRIBUTING.md` — monorepo conventions (commit style, branch model, `pnpm` only, never `npm install` in a sub-package, how to add a new package, ESLint boundary rules).

**Per package** (`packages/protocol`, `packages/core`, `packages/agent`, `apps/cli`, `packages/test-helpers`, `e2e`)

Each has:

- `package.json` — `name: "@yantra/<pkg>"`, `version: "0.0.0"`, `type: "module"`, `main: "./dist/index.js"`, `types: "./dist/index.d.ts"`, `exports: { ".": { "import": "./dist/index.js", "types": "./dist/index.d.ts" } }`, `scripts: { build: "tsc -b", test: "vitest run", lint: "eslint src", typecheck: "tsc --noEmit", clean: "rimraf dist .turbo" }`.
- `tsconfig.json` — extends `../../tsconfig.base.json`; `include: ["src/**/*"]`; `exclude: ["**/*.spec.ts"]`; package-specific overrides (`composite: true` for build references where applicable).
- `tsconfig.build.json` — narrower variant used by the solution-style root references (`outDir: ./dist`, `rootDir: ./src`).
- `vitest.config.ts` — `defineConfig({ test: { environment: 'node', include: ['src/**/*.spec.ts'] } })`.
- `src/index.ts` — minimal real named export (no default exports per memory).
- `src/index.spec.ts` — at least one `@no-llm` smoke test.

**Package-specific notes**

- `packages/protocol/package.json` — runtime dependencies: empty (placeholder for `zod` arriving in FEAT-002); test-time devDep on `@yantra/test-helpers`.
- `packages/core/package.json` — runtime dependency on `@yantra/protocol` (`workspace:*`); test devDep on `@yantra/test-helpers`.
- `packages/agent/package.json` — runtime dependency on `@yantra/protocol` (`workspace:*`); test devDep on `@yantra/test-helpers`. **No dependency on `@yantra/core` at all**; ESLint additionally blocks the import path (TASK-006). ## 4. Dependencies

This feature has **no upstream feature dependencies** — it is the foundation. External tooling versions (latest LTS / stable per memory):

- **Node**: 24.15.0 LTS (pinned via `.nvmrc` and CI `actions/setup-node@v4` with `node-version-file: '.nvmrc'`).
- **pnpm**: 9.x (latest stable; declared in `packageManager` field of root `package.json` and installed in CI via `pnpm/action-setup@v4`).
- **Turborepo**: 2.x.
- **TypeScript**: 5.x (latest stable).
- **Vitest**: 2.x.
- **ESLint**: 9.x (flat config) — if 9.x flat-config tooling for the chosen plugins is incomplete, fall back to ESLint 8.x with `.eslintrc.cjs`; either is acceptable. Decision recorded in TASK-006.
- **Prettier**: 3.x.
- **lefthook**: 1.x (chosen over husky for zero-install simplicity).
- **lint-staged**: 15.x.
- **Changesets** (`@changesets/cli`): 2.x — bootstraps `.changeset/` for future versioning, but no release automation in this feature.

Downstream features (FEAT-002+) all depend on this scaffold.

### TASK-007: Vitest workspace mode + `@no-llm` / `@requires-llm` tag plumbing

- [ ] **Implementation**: Create `vitest.workspace.ts` at repo root referencing every package's `vitest.config.ts`. Implement `packages/test-helpers/src/index.ts` with:
  ```ts
  import { it } from 'vitest';
  export const llmProvider = (): string => process.env.LLM_PROVIDER ?? 'none';
  export const hasLlm = (): boolean => llmProvider() !== 'none';
  export const itRequiresLlm: typeof it = it.skipIf(!hasLlm()) as typeof it;
  ```
  Convention: tests that exercise the LLM path use `itRequiresLlm(...)` instead of `it(...)`; tests that must pass in both modes use plain `it(...)` and document `// @no-llm` at the top of the describe block. Add a single integration spec under `packages/test-helpers/src/index.spec.ts` that verifies all three branches (forces `LLM_PROVIDER` to `none`, `anthropic`, and `ollama` via `vi.stubEnv`). `hasLlm()` returns `true` for both `anthropic` and `ollama`; only `none` (or unset) returns `false`.
  Root `package.json` adds `scripts.test:no-llm` → `LLM_PROVIDER=none turbo run test` (cross-platform via `cross-env` — install it).

### TASK-008: GitHub Actions CI matrix (3 OS × {anthropic, none} + ubuntu × ollama)

- [ ] **Implementation**: Create `.github/workflows/ci.yml`:
  ```yaml
  name: ci
  on:
    push: { branches: [main] }
    pull_request:
  jobs:
    ci:
      strategy:
        fail-fast: false
        matrix:
          # Cartesian for anthropic/none across 3 OSes (6 cells) …
          os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
          llm-provider: [anthropic, none]
          # … plus a single ubuntu × ollama cell via include (7 cells total).
          # Ollama runs only on ubuntu because the model server bootstraps in
          # the runner and tripling it across macOS/Windows is too slow per plan §9.
          include:
            - os: ubuntu-latest
              llm-provider: ollama
      runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
      env:
        LLM_PROVIDER: ${{ matrix.llm-provider }}
      steps:
        - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
          with:
            node-version-file: '.nvmrc'
            cache: 'pnpm'
        # Ollama-only setup step: pulls and starts an ollama daemon on ubuntu.
        # FEAT-011 owns the model choice; this scaffold step just installs the runtime
        # so downstream features have a working `LLM_PROVIDER=ollama` cell.
        - name: Setup Ollama
          if: matrix.llm-provider == 'ollama'
          run: |
            curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh
            ollama serve &
            # Wait for daemon to be ready (no sleep loop — query the endpoint).
            until curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags >/dev/null; do sleep 1; done
        - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
        - run: pnpm lint
        - run: pnpm typecheck
        - run: pnpm build
        - run: pnpm test
  ```
  Pin all `actions/*` to current major versions. Configure Turborepo remote cache as **off** for now (Phase 2 enhancement noted in TODO). The `anthropic` and `ollama` matrix legs do **not** require API keys or pulled models in this feature (no LLM is called by the scaffold itself); the env var is set and the daemon is up so downstream features inherit a working matrix. The actual model pull (`ollama pull <model>`) belongs to FEAT-011's CI setup step. Add a `concurrency: { group: ci-${{ github.ref }}, cancel-in-progress: true }` block to cut wasted runs.

## 6. Cross-Cutting Concerns

- **Auth**: N/A — the scaffold neither authenticates nor talks to a network beyond the package registry.
- **Error Handling**: ESLint, TypeScript, and Vitest failures fail CI; there is no runtime error path in this feature. Hook failures (`lefthook` pre-commit) block local commits with a clear error message. No `process.exit(0)` on any failure anywhere (memory §Error Handling).
- **Logging**: N/A — the scaffold doesn't run any application code. Future logging via `pino` is introduced in later features.
- **Security**:
  - Architectural boundaries are the security feature shipped here. `packages/agent` cannot import `packages/core` (compiler + ESLint enforced); only `packages/agent` may import `pi-agent-core` (ESLint enforced). This implements memory §Architecture (`agent` cannot import `core` — compiler-enforced) and §Dependencies (Direct `pi-agent-core` invocations outside `packages/agent` are forbidden).
  - `.gitignore` includes `.env*` to prevent accidental secret commits even though no env files exist yet.
  - `pnpm audit` is wired into CI in a follow-up feature (FEAT-002 or FEAT-012 — noted in TODO; this feature does not run audit to keep the foundation green on day one).
  - `LICENSE` is MIT, pending user confirmation in TASK-010.
- **Testing**: The CI matrix (3 OS × {anthropic, none} + ubuntu × ollama = 7 cells) is the headline deliverable. **All three provider legs (`anthropic`, `ollama`, `none`) must be green for the merge to be considered complete** — Anthropic and none on Ubuntu/macOS/Windows; Ollama on Ubuntu. The scaffold tests are trivial (one smoke test per package); their job is to prove every package's build/test/lint/typecheck pipeline works on every cell. Real test coverage arrives feature-by-feature.
